arxiv-2104-10484.title: Revealing hidden magneto-electric multipoles using Compton scattering
arxiv-2104-10484.creator: Sayantika Bhowal, Nicola A. Spaldin
arxiv-2104-10484.description: Abstract Magneto-electric multipoles, which are odd under both space-inversion ℐ \cal I and time-reversal 𝒯 \cal T symmetries, are fundamental in understanding and characterizing magneto-electric materials. However, the detection of these magneto-electric multipoles is often not straightforward as they remain “hidden” in conventional experiments in part since many magneto-electrics exhibit combined ℐ𝒯 \cal IT symmetry.

arxiv-2203-09198.title: White Paper: AWAKE, Plasma Wakefield Acceleration of Electron Bunches for Near and Long Term Particle Physics Applications
arxiv-2203-09198.creator: P. Muggli, AWAKE Collaboration
arxiv-2203-09198.description:
A 2022 arXiv research paper by P. Muggli, AWAKE Collaboration. I
Executive summary

Plasma-based accelerators have made remarkable progress over the last two decades. Their unique characteristics make them tools that can revolutionize fields of science and applications. AWAKE takes advantage of the availability of high-energy, relativistic proton bunches to drive large amplitude wakefields (
\sim
GV/m) in a single plasma over distances sufficient to produce hundreds of GeV to TeV electron bunches.

arxiv-2402-17903.creator: Jingying Wang, Haoran Tang, Taylor Kantor, Tandis Soltani, Vitaliy Popov, Xu Wang
arxiv-2402-17903.description: Abstract . Videos are prominent learning materials to prepare surgical trainees before they enter the operating room (OR). In this work, we explore techniques to enrich the video-based surgery learning experience. We propose Surgment, a system that helps expert surgeons create exercises with feedback based on surgery recordings.

arxiv-2407-20038.title: Optimal Control of a Battery Storage On the Energy Market
arxiv-2407-20038.creator: Stephan Schlüter, Abhinav Das, Matthew Davison
arxiv-2407-20038.description: Abstract Electricity storage is crucial for a successful transition towards carbon-neutral energy production. Despite considerable research and a number of promising future alternatives such as hydrogen, battery storages currently remain the first choice. However, costs remain high and it remains to be shown whether an investment can be profitable.

arxiv-2410-01196.title: Expected Diverse Utility (EDU): Diverse Bayesian Optimization of Expensive Computer Simulators
arxiv-2410-01196.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by . The optimization of expensive black-box simulators arises in a myriad of modern scientific and engineering applications. Bayesian optimization provides an appealing solution, by leveraging a fitted surrogate model to guide the selection of subsequent simulator evaluations. In practice, however, the objective is often not to obtain a single good solution, but rather a “basket” of good solutions from which users can choose for downstream decision-making.

arxiv-2505-16883.title: Test-Field vs Physical Quasi-Normal Modes in Scalar-Tensor Theories
arxiv-2505-16883.creator: Alexandre Arbey, Etera R. Livine, Clara Montagnon
arxiv-2505-16883.description: Abstract In the context of the general effort to model black hole dynamics, and in particular their return-to-equilibrium through quasi-normal modes, it is crucial to understand how much test-field perturbations deviate from physical perturbations in modified gravity scenarios. On the one hand, physical perturbations follow the modified Einstein equations of the considered extension of general relativity.

pmc-10531757.creator: Alena B Zuzina, Aliya Kh Vinarskaya, Pavel M Balaban, Changjong Moon
pmc-10531757.description: This work aims to study the epigenetic mechanisms of regulating long-term context memory in the gastropod mollusk: Helix.
